lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is Tuesday's Town Council meeting, where second reading of the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code hits the floor — this is a vote that would write new landscaping, tree, and historic-review standards into the Land Use Code, so it's worth paying attention. Also Tuesday, the Housing Authority takes up a real policy question about primary residency rules for dependents in multi-custodial households. Meanwhile, the County's sixth Land Use Code working session on Wednesday is shaping the final recommendations that will determine how and where affordable and workforce housing gets built across the region.

notable.stake: Final recommendations forming on county zoning rules for affordable/workforce housing.
Second reading vote on wildfire code changes to town landscaping and historic-review standards.
Policy decision on primary residency rules affecting multi-custodial households in deed-restricted housing.
